1.consolidated_definition: Amigo. “Ni su amistad, Galante, era hombre rico.” Zeno Gandía, La charca, 1893, cap. I. (Ac. consigna amor por la ‘persona amada’, pero no amistad por ‘amigo’, usual en todas partes).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Friend. "Neither his friendship, Galante, was a rich man." Zeno Gandía, The Pond, 1893, chap. I. (Ac. consigns love for the 'beloved person', but not friendship for 'friend', usual everywhere).
